name: Aunt Mimi’s Cake Pops & More
currentNote: No website and no domain. Before is what assistants, a web search and the Facebook, Instagram and Google Maps pages give (ADR 0012).

site.label: Wait before the page shows on a phone
site.why: Visitors see each page in 1.0 s on average.
site.impact: People leave slow pages before they find your number.
site.fine: Largest Contentful Paint, mean of 6 pages; 6 of 6 within 2.5 s.

site.label: Speed on a phone, out of 100
site.why: Most people check out a business on a phone first.
site.fine: Google Lighthouse performance score, mean of 6 pages.

site.label: Ready for Google, out of 100
site.why: Nothing basic is missing when Google decides how to list you.
site.fine: Google Lighthouse SEO score on phones, mean of 6 pages.

site.label: Usable by every visitor, out of 100
site.why: Customers using a screen reader or large text can read and use every page.
site.fine: Google Lighthouse accessibility score on phones, mean of 6 pages.

site.label: Pages with your business details for Google
site.why: Your name, address, phones and menu, in the form search engines read.
site.fine: Structured data (JSON-LD), valid against schema.org with Google’s required local business properties.

ai.label: Your facts within an AI assistant’s reach
ai.why: People ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude instead of searching.
ai.impact: Today an assistant that searches finds a few of your facts. The new site writes them down where an assistant can read them.
ai.fine: Two measures, not one. Before: what Claude Sonnet with web search found, mean of its runs, of 36 facts (name and town were in the question). After: facts the launch build states in text or JSON-LD, of 40. No assistant has been asked about the new site; it is not live.
ai.before: 8.3 of 36 found by an assistant with web search
ai.after: 40 of 40 written on the site where an assistant can read them

ai.label: Facts an assistant knows without searching
ai.why: From memory, no assistant knows the shop yet.
ai.fine: The best of 3 Claude models with no tools, of 36 facts.

ai.label: Your facts readable as words
ai.why: Search engines and assistants read words, not photos.
ai.fine: Before: stated as text on Facebook, Instagram or Google Maps. After: in the launch build’s text, scripts off, across 6 pages. Of 40 facts.

ai.label: Facts only in photos, now written out
ai.why: Flavors and prices live in photos today, where no program can read them.
ai.fine: Facts readable today only inside a photo that the launch build states in text or JSON-LD.

ai.label: Web search: found today, and ready to be listed
ai.why: Today a customer searching for cake pops in Bartlett does not find you.
ai.impact: The new site lets search engines index every page and lists each one for them; where it ranks is up to them.
ai.fine: Two measures, not one. Before: searches run once each, observed; one search tool, not Google. After: pages search engines are allowed to index and the sitemap lists. Ranking cannot be measured before the site is live.
ai.after: 6 of 6 pages search engines may index, all in the sitemap
